description.value: Anarchy Coffee Roasters is a punk rock-inspired specialty coffee roaster and cafe in Kelowna, roasting small-batch, ethically sourced beans on-site and serving them alongside food in a community-minded shop. Founded in 2019 out of a passion for quality coffee and music, the business offers single-origin coffees, espresso blends, decaf options, and even in-house espresso machine repair services. Touring cyclists will find a characterful, welcoming stop with fresh-roasted coffee and food in the heart of Kelowna.

address.value: 1880 Baron Rd C-Unit, Kelowna, BC, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms a real, operating cafe and roastery at 1880 Baron Rd C-Unit, Kelowna, with phone (250) 878-2099 matching OSM. OSM had no address field; the address is sourced from the website, and a minor discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours and the website (no times included per rules, but flagged in concerns).
